observations.behavior: Adds free-only scanner and free-credits-aware quota accounting, including new status fields, updated spend calculations, and helper functions for free-credit coverage and remaining free credits.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision scanner status and quota accounting now distinguish between a user-imposed credit limit and the organization's free-tier allowance, and account for the case where the free allowance becomes the binding constraint.

observations.behavior: Adds free_only, credit_limit, and limit_from_free_credits fields to ScannerStatus and exports them in ScannerStatusFields; updates scannerStatus to populate these fields when limit_reached; extends spendAgainstLimit to use free credits when the scanner is free-only and the org's free allowance is the binding constraint.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision status and spend calculations now support the scenario where a free-only scanner is bounded by the organization's free-tier allowance rather than a user-set limit, and report whether the limit came from free credits.

observations.behavior: Adds freeCredits and freeCreditsCoverage fields to SpendAgainstLimit; freeCreditsCoverage returns a human-readable string describing how long the free allowance covers the current spend; freeCreditsLeft returns remaining free credits after accounting for current usage.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision quota accounting now distinguishes between billable and free-tier consumption, and provides human-readable estimates of how long free credits will last.
